title: Chagra, brother of Rabbi Ba bar Bina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 9, at the additional supplied locator 12a: he gave a Torah scroll to Rav Chananel (who was a scribe), and did not find one complete column in it.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The additional יב. locator is retained as historical page 12a, without converting it into a range of halakhot 9–12 or identifying a modern edition. A Torah-scroll דף is a column.

The whole Guggenheimer Megillah 1:9 paragraph explicitly has Chagra, brother of Rabbi Ba bar Bina, giving a Torah scroll to Rav Chananel. It eventually says he found one complete column and saved the whole scroll. Hyman instead supplies “did not find one complete column”; that negative remains his report, without changing it to agree with the digital passage. Local full titles are supported. The existing 12a note remains without printed-edition collation or sibling identity binding.
